files.role: saved scene (subway base with placed assets)

components.explanation: The saved subway-base scene. Each asset is one instance of its imported .glb with an identity basis (scale 1) at y = 0.25, the top of the 0.5 m floor slab; the tablet carries a tilt and sits at y 0.664 as a display placement. Two cameras (preview_camera, a3_asset_camera) and three omni lights; no scripts.
ENV-SEAT-02: the start-menu chair, 6 shapes, 72 triangles, 0.44 x 0.42 x 0.90 m, origin at the bottom centre. Rebuilt headless (script route) from the 9-box v1; imported with default settings.
PROP-TABLET-02: the rugged military tablet, 21 bevelled boxes (over the course limit of 6 by the designer's decision), 388 triangles, origin kept at the geometric centre (lowest y -0.081).

CRATE-LONG-03 and CRATE-CUBE-02: weapon crates on the 0.1 m grid (1.0 x 0.5 x 0.4 m and a 0.5 m cube), 88 triangles each, lid origin on the back hinge, open / close animations (0 to -100 deg, 15 frames at 24 fps). The small crate carries the designer's hand edit (latches on the seam, handles higher).
Extra project assets beyond the three: a 1.5 x 0.5 m computer desk and a 1.5 x 1.0 m L-shaped desk, 6 shapes and 72 triangles each, on the 0.1 m grid.

SceneTree script written by Claude: Part 1 loads each .glb and compares size, lowest point, node scales and triangles with the brief, and plays the crate animations to their last frame; Part 2 instantiates base.tscn and checks floor contact, the 0.1 m grid and pairwise overlaps. 55 PASS, exit 0. It cannot judge appearance.

		if a[0].begins_with("crate"):
			_check(ap != null and ap.has_animation("open") and ap.has_animation("close"), "has open and close animations")
			if ap:
				var lid := inst.find_child("*_Lid", true, false) as Node3D
				ap.play("open"); ap.seek(ap.get_animation("open").length, true)
				_check(is_equal_approx(snappedf(lid.rotation_degrees.x, 0.01), -100.0), "after open the lid is at -100 deg (%.2f)" % lid.rotation_degrees.x)
				ap.play("close"); ap.seek(ap.get_animation("close").length, true)
				_check(is_equal_approx(snappedf(lid.rotation_degrees.x, 0.01), 0.0), "after close the lid is back at 0 deg (%.2f)" % lid.rotation_degrees.x)

for name in FLOOR_ITEMS:
		_check(absf(boxes[name].position.y - floor_top) <= TOL, "%s rests on the floor (y = %.3f)" % [name, floor_top])
	for name in GRID_ITEMS:
		var b: AABB = boxes[name]
		var on_grid := true
		for v in [b.position.x, b.position.z, b.end.x, b.end.z]:
			on_grid = on_grid and absf(v * 10.0 - roundf(v * 10.0)) <= TOL * 10.0
		_check(on_grid, "%s footprint edges sit on the 0.1 m grid" % name)
